Oakwood Residence Saigon
Luxury Serviced Apartments in Ho Chi Minh City
1056A Nguyen Van Linh Boulevard, Tan Phong Ward, District 7, 700000, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Experience a luxury serviced apartment at Oakwood Residence Saigon, where comfort meets the feeling of home. Ideal for business trips, family stays, relocations and pet-friendly accommodation.

Located near Phu My Hung area (District 7), just 15 minutes from the city centre, with direct access to SC VivoCity mall, and close to international schools, hospitals, and diverse dining options.

Enjoy spacious apartments with city views, fully equipped kitchens, modern living areas, and other premium AMENITIES.

Our commitment to your well-being is underscored by the implementation of the Ascott Cares programme, ensuring stringent hygiene standards.

Enjoy your perfect home away from home with a comfortable and memorable experience.

Discover fully furnished serviced apartments in Ho Chi Minh City, ranging from studio to 3-bedroom units in a space where comfort and convenience collide.

Situated in Ho Chi Minh City's fast growing new urban center of Phu My Hung in District 7, Oakwood Residence Saigon offers 237 fully furnished, elegantly appointed serviced apartments - ranging from studio to three-bedroom units.

10 minutes away from Phu My Hung.

Relocating families will appreciate the ideal location - perfectly nestled in an expat neighborhood surrounded by numerous international schools, hospitals, shops and eateries, while business travelers can also enjoy easy access to the CBD and various industrial zones. As part of an integrated mixed-use development (Saigon South Place) which includes the lifestyle shopping mall of SC VivoCity, Oakwood Residence Saigon offers the best both worlds - comfort and convenience in an oasis of tranquility.

Sustainability Information
Carbon Footprint: 11.71Kg per room night
Water Footprint: 80.5 litres per room night

A New Green Milestone
Sustainability has always been at the heart of our journey. We are proud to announce that Oakwood Residence Saigon has been awarded the Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC) Certification, one of the most respected and internationally recognised sustainability certifications in the hospitality industry.
This achievement reflects our commitment to responsible hospitality across all GSTC criteria, including:
- Sustainable management
- Socioeconomic impacts
- Cultural impacts
- Environmental impacts
It demonstrates that sustainability is embedded throughout our operations and guides the way we serve our guests, support our associates, and engage with the local community.
Every initiative, every improvement, and every conscious choice has contributed to creating a more sustainable living environment and generating a positive impact beyond our property.

Location
Oakwood Residence Saigon is ideally situated next to Phu My Hung (District 7), a dynamic and international urban area in Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC). The residence offers excellent connectivity to the city centre, only a 10 to 15-minute drive away. This convenient positioning allows residents to easily access the city's commercial and cultural pulse while enjoying the peaceful environment of Phu My Hung.

The integration with the adjacent SC VivoCity shopping mall provides direct access to extensive retail and dining options. This is truly a perfect home for your family, as top-tier healthcare facilities, international schools, and a variety of dining choices surround the location. For local leisure, you can explore nearby attractions such as the scenic Crescent Lake and the illuminated Starlight Bridge.

Getting to Oakwood Residence Saigon
From Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN):
By Taxi/Private Transfer: The airport is approximately 12.9 to 15 kilometres away. The journey typically takes around 35 to 41 minutes by car.

Nearest Public Transport from Oakwood Residence Saigon:
Local Bus Routes: Several bus routes serve the area, with stops such as Sky Garden and Trạm Xe Giao Lộ Nguyễn Hữu Thọ located within a short walking distance.
Taxis and Ride-Hailing Services (Grab): Readily available for convenient travel throughout the city.
City Centre Access: The city centre (District 1) is approximately a 10-15-minute drive.

We offer four types of spacious serviced apartments:
- Studio units

- Two-bedroom units

Each apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen (Induction hob, hood, oven and microwave), a washing machine and other modern amenities.

Official FAQ — Is Oakwood Residence Saigon a suitable luxury hotel option in Ho Chi Minh City?
Oakwood Residence Saigon offers luxury serviced apartments with five-star amenities and services, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a premium stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

Official FAQ — What facilities can guests enjoy at Oakwood Residence Saigon?
Guests have access to:
- A fitness centre
- Panoramic swimming pools
- Kids playground
- BBQ pavilion
- A putting range
- Residents' Lounge
- Meeting facilities

- Car park

Official FAQ — Where is Oakwood Residence Saigon located?
Oakwood Residence Saigon is situated at 1056A Nguyen Van Linh Boulevard, Tan Hung Ward (District 7), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It is in near the upscale Phu My Hung area, known for its international community and amenities.

Official FAQ — How far is Oakwood Residence Saigon from the city centre of Ho Chi Minh City?
Oakwood Residence Saigon is approximately 5.4 kilometres from the city centre (District 1), typically a 10 to 15-minute drive, depending on traffic conditions.

Official FAQ — Are there shopping and dining options near Oakwood Residence Saigon?
Yes, Oakwood Residence Saigon is part of the Saigon South Place development, offering direct access to SC VivoCity, a popular lifestyle shopping mall with diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options. The Phu My Hung neighbourhood also features numerous shops and eateries. There is also a new Korean F&B hub at Pham Van Nghi street, just a five-minute walk from the property.

Official FAQ — What public transport options are available near Oakwood Residence Saigon?
Several public bus routes serve the area, with stops like Sky Garden and Tram Xe Giao Lo Nguyen Huu Tho within walking distance. Taxis and ride-hailing services are also readily available for convenient travel.

Discover Somerset Chancellor Court, a distinguished serviced apartment residence situated in the vibrant heart of Ho Chi Minh City. Our prime location in District 1 places you amidst the city's bustling business, diplomatic, and major shopping districts. From here, you are perfectly positioned to explore the captivating blend of historical charm and modern energy that defines this dynamic metropolis. Enjoy easy access to iconic landmarks, cultural sites, and a diverse array of dining and retail experiences, all within a comfortable distance from your refined residence. Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor swimming pool or maintain your fitness routine at the well-equipped gymnasium. Families will appreciate the dedicated children's playroom and play area. For moments of relaxation, a steam room is available, and a convenience store is located on-site for immediate needs. We are committed to providing a safe and comfortable environment for all our guests. Our attentive team is available 24 hours a day at reception, ready to assist with laundry and dry cleaning, courier services, and room service. Official FAQ — What are the check-in and check-out times at Somerset Chancellor Court?
Check-in time for Somerset Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City is 2:00 PM and check-out time is 12:00 PM.

Official FAQ — What is the cancellation policy if you wish to cancel the booking?
The cancellation policy is at least 24 hours before the day of arrival.

The cancellation policy may depend on our specific promotions. Please refer to Somerset Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City cancellation policy on our site for more details about any exclusions or requirements.

Official FAQ — Does Somerset Chancellor Court allow pets?
No, pets are not allowed at Somerser Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City.

Official FAQ — What is the smoking policy at Somerset Chancellor Court?
Somerser Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City does not permit smoking in public areas and inside the room, but allows smoking on the balcony.

Official FAQ — What types of apartments are available at Somerset Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City?
Somerset Chancellor Court offers a range of spacious serviced apartments, including Studio Executive, One-Bedroom Executive, Two-Bedroom Executive, One-Bedroom Premier, Two-Bedroom Premier, and Three-Bedroom Apartments, suitable for various travel needs.

Official FAQ — How much is an extra bed?
An extra bed is chargeable at VND650,000++ per night for every room type.

Official FAQ — Is there car parking available at Somerset Chancellor Court?
Yes, car parking is available at Somerser Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City.

Official FAQ — Is breakfast included at Somerset Chancellor Court?
Yes, breakfast is included. Breakfast is served at Morico restaurant on the Ground Floor.

Official FAQ — Is there housekeeping service?
Yes, we offer housekeeping daily for short-stay guests and three times a week for long stay guests (except Sunday & Public Holiday).

Official FAQ — What amenities can guests expect in their apartment?
Each apartment is fully furnished and air-conditioned, featuring an open kitchen with a microwave, refrigerator, stovetop, and cookware. You will also find a washing machine with a dryer, a home entertainment system with SMART TV, complimentary WiFi, and an en-suite bathroom with toiletries.

Official FAQ — What dining options are available at the property?
The property features an on-site restaurant and a coffee shop, where guests can enjoy daily breakfast and other meals.

Official FAQ — Are there facilities for children at Somerset Chancellor Court?
Yes, families will find a dedicated children's playroom and play area at Somerset Chancellor Court, providing engaging activities for younger guests.

Official FAQ — How far is Somerset Chancellor Court from major attractions like Ben Thanh Market?
Somerset Chancellor Court is centrally located in District 1. The Saigon Notre-Dame Basilica and Central Post Office are approximately 500 metres away, while Ben Thanh Market is about 1.5 to 2 kilometres from the residence.

Official FAQ — What public transport options are available near Somerset Chancellor Court?
The residence is well-served by public transport. The new Metro Line 1 has stations nearby, including Ben Thanh Station, and numerous bus routes operate in the central area. Taxis and ride-hailing services are also readily available.

Official FAQ — Does Somerset Chancellor Court Ho Chi Minh City offer airport transfer services?
Yes, airport transfer services to and from Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) are available upon request and at an additional charge. The airport is approximately a 25-30 minute drive away.

Location
Somerset Vista Ho Chi Minh City is ideally situated in An Khanh, a highly sought-after neighbourhood renowned for its cosmopolitan lifestyle and popularity among expatriates. This area offers a unique blend of local Vietnamese culture and modern conveniences. You will find yourself surrounded by a diverse selection of dining options, from charming local eateries to international bistros and cafés. For your shopping needs, MM Mega Market and An Phu Supermarket are conveniently located within a short walking distance, ensuring daily essentials are easily accessible. The residence is also connected to The Vista, offering further exclusive retail and dining experiences.

Our prime location ensures excellent connectivity to the city's key hubs and attractions. Popular destinations such as Landmark 81 and the Saigon River are only minutes away. The city centre is accessible via a short drive. Public transport options are readily accessible: the Rach Chiec Metro Station is just an 8-minute walk (approximately 500 metres), and the An Phu Metro Station is about 1.2 kilometres away, a 19-minute walk. This central position ensures you can navigate the city with ease, experiencing the best of Ho Chi Minh City effortlessly.

Getting Here
From Tan Son Nhat International Airport:
By taxi (50 minutes): After the Saigon bridge, turn right into Tran Nao road. Do a U-turn into Thao Dien. Go straight on Song Hanh road. In Thao Dien, turn right into Tran Ngoc Dien road, turn right into Nguyen U Di road, turn right into Vo Truong Toan road and left into Song Hanh road. After Giang Van Minh street, go straight to Somerset Vista. It costs approximately VND260,000.
By 16-seat vans and above (55 minutes): Via Hanoi Highway, cross Parkson and you can see Minh Dang Quang Pagoda, then turn right to Mai Chi Tho Boulevard. After about 2 kilometres, make a U-turn via Luong Dinh Cua Street to Mai Chi Tho Boulevard. Go over the bridge and turn right onto Giang Van Minh Street before making a right-turn via internal road along The Oxygen. The residence is on the right along Hanoi Highway.

Somerset Ho Chi Minh City
Ho Chi Minh City Serviced Apartments
No 8A Nguyen Binh Khiem Street, Sai Gon Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Experience refined urban living at Somerset Ho Chi Minh City, where spacious and elegant serviced apartments offer a welcoming retreat in the vibrant heart of the city. Situated in Saigon Ward, our residence places you amidst Ho Chi Minh City’s dynamic blend of commerce and culture, with an array of bistros, cafés, and restaurants right on your doorstep. This convenient location ensures you are perfectly positioned to explore the city’s many attractions, whether you are here for business, a project assignment, or a family relocation, making it an ideal executive base.

Our thoughtfully designed apartments range from comfortable one-bedroom layouts to expansive three-bedroom residences, providing ample space for discerning executives and international families alike. Each apartment features a fully equipped modern kitchen, ideal for preparing your own meals, and an en-suite bathroom. You will also find modern conveniences, including an in-suite washer and dryer, multi-split air conditioning, and an in-room electronic safe, ensuring a comfortable and practical stay. Complimentary wireless internet connectivity is available throughout your apartment, keeping you seamlessly connected.

Somerset Ho Chi Minh City offers a comprehensive selection of exclusive facilities and services designed to enhance your stay. Start your day with a delicious breakfast at our lounge, or enjoy a leisurely swim in the outdoor swimming pool. Maintain your fitness routine in our well-equipped gymnasium or participate in a class in the aerobics and yoga room. For active guests, tennis courts are available. Families will appreciate the dedicated children's playground, children's wading pool, and the engaging Cubbies Kids Club. A relaxing Jacuzzi and a barbecue area are also provided for outdoor enjoyment.

Beyond the extensive recreational options, our services include daily housekeeping, a 24-hour reception, and robust 24-hour security for your peace of mind. For your convenience, a grocery store is located on-site. Our friendly staff organise a variety of social and cultural residents' programmes and offer airport transfer services and a shuttle bus service to key city locations, ensuring a truly seamless transition and memorable experience.

Within a 10 to 15-minute walk, you can immerse yourself in history and culture at the HCMC History Museum, the historic Notre Dame Catholic Cathedral, the Central Post Office, and the War Remnants Memorial Museum.

The neighbourhood offers unparalleled convenience for business and leisure. For shopping enthusiasts, Dong Khoi Street and various shopping centres are nearby, with Ben Thanh Market just a 15-minute drive away. The surrounding area also provides convenient access to key business destinations and consulates. Future connectivity is strong, with forthcoming metro lines such as Văn Thánh Park (1.1 km) and Ba Son (1.4 km) stations in close proximity, ensuring you are well connected to all that this captivating city has to offer.
